title.narrative: Intervento multisettoriale di emergenza ed early recovery in risposta alla crisi umanitaria protratta in Siria
Multisectoral emergency and early recovery response to the protracted humanitarian crisis in Syria

description.narrative: Il progetto ha l’obiettivo specifico di fornire assistenza umanitaria salvavita, rafforzare il livello di protezione per le fasce più vulnerabili della popolazione e promuovere la resilienza delle comunità colpite dalla crisi protratta in Siria. I risultati attesi comprendono: - Garantito l’accesso a servizi salvavita nei settori WASH, salute e sicurezza alimentare per le popolazioni vulnerabili colpite dalla crisi in Siria. - Migliorato l’accesso a servizi di base e infrastrutture comunitarie inclusive, sicure e resilienti. - Rafforzato il sostentamento economico della popolazione vulnerabile attraverso opportunità generatrici di reddito e mezzi di sussistenza dignitosi. Potenziato l’accesso a servizi di protezione integrati e centrati sulla persona, con attivazione di meccanismi efficaci e accessibili di prevenzione e risposta alla violenza di genere e al PSEA, anche attraverso sistemi comunitari e referral inter-agency.

The project’s specific objective is to provide life-saving humanitarian assistance, strengthen the level of protection for the most vulnerable segments of the population, and promote the resilience of communities affected by the protracted crisis in Syria. The expected results include: - Ensured access to life-saving services in the WASH, health, and food security sectors for vulnerable populations affected by the crisis in Syria. - Improved access to basic services and inclusive, safe, and resilient community infrastructure. - Strengthened economic livelihoods of vulnerable populations through income-generating opportunities and dignified means of subsistence. Enhanced access to integrated, person-centered protection services, including the establishment of effective and accessible prevention and response mechanisms to gender-based violence and PSEA, also through community-based systems and inter-agency referral pathways.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2030, double the agricultural productivity and incomes of small-scale food producers, in particular women, indigenous peoples, family farmers, pastoralists and fishers, including through secure and equal access to land, other productive resources and inputs, knowledge, financial services, markets and opportunities for value addition and non-farm employment
By 2030, ensure that all girls and boys complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education leading to relevant and effective learning outcomes
By 2030, eradicate extreme poverty for all people everywhere, currently measured as people living on less than $1.25 a day
By 2030, reduce by one third premature mortality from non-communicable diseases through prevention and treatment and promote mental health and well-being
By 2030, reduce the global maternal mortality ratio to less than 70 per 100,000 live births
Eliminate all forms of violence against all women and girls in the public and private spheres, including trafficking and sexual and other types of exploitation
End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all
